title: Data Science
summary: How data science turns raw information into insight and discovery.

scenes.title: Super Detectives of Information
scenes.narration: Data science is like being a super detective for information! We collect clues from all around the 🌍 world to solve big mysteries and help us understand things better.

scenes.title: Collecting Clues (Data)
scenes.narration: Imagine you're counting all your red 🍎 apples. Each count is a piece of data, a clue! Data scientists gather millions of these clues, like how many people like bananas or how tall trees grow.

scenes.title: Sorting & Finding Patterns
scenes.narration: Once we have clues, we use special 💻 computers and 🧮 math to sort them super fast. This helps us find patterns, like noticing that most kids love playing with building blocks!

scenes.title: Making Smart Choices
scenes.narration: If you watch lots of superhero 🍿 movies, data science helps your TV 📺 recommend more superhero shows you'll 👍 like! It uses what you enjoyed before to guess what's next.

scenes.title: Building a Better World
scenes.narration: By understanding patterns, data science helps grown-ups make smart decisions, like building safer roads or designing new toys kids will love. It helps us make our 🌎 world a better place!
